# Journal of #2123 Every night-bot run on #2123, and on the pull requests that close it, adds a section here when it ends, oldest first (`bot/harness/journal.py`). The next run reads the end of this file, as `.bot-journal.md` in its worktree, before it starts. ## 2026-10-27 22:32 UTC · plan #2123 · `claude-8` · planned [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40591931645) on `claude-8` (`opus` (strong)). It ended **planned**: planned on opus Model calls: 1, 11.4 model minutes. Tokens: 148 in / 72331 out / 8608211 cached, $4.54. Its work ended at `5e130b133512` on `bot/issue-2123`. | # | When (UTC) | Step | Why | Took | What came of it | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | 22:08 | start | from `origin/main` | | at `5e130b133512` | | 2 | 22:08 | plan (`opus`) | plan the item before anyone builds it | 11.4 min, 72479 tok, $4.54 | ended, 78 turns |
The builder's notes when it stopped ````markdown # Plan (opus, strong) ## Goal Every number that changes in place or stands in a column on the menus and the turn clock gets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. That covers the clock's digits, the shop's wallet, counts and prices, held tokens and packs, the bar captions, XP levels and quest pay, the collection's set completion and lists, the leaderboard's ranks and ratings, and the stats tables, figures and pager. `apps/web/src/index.css` gains one section that balances `h1`–`h3`, the dialog and toast titles that are not headings and the result's word, and gives paragraphs the `pretty` wrap. A new stylesheet test, `apps/web/src/typography.test.ts`, in the style of `fx/css.test.ts`, holds all three requirements: the number classes, the `index.css` rule, and no new `text-wrap` or `font-variant-numeric` on any card-face selector. ## Files to touch | Path | Kind | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/clock.css` | change | `.clock-digits` gets `tabular-nums` | | `apps/web/src/shop/shop.css` | change | `.shop-wallet` and `.shop-row__info` get it; new rule `.token-held, .cosmetic-packs-held` | | `apps/web/src/packs/packs.css` | change | `.packs-held` | | `apps/web/src/economy/economy.css` | change | `.fill-bar__caption` (the base rule, not the phone one) | | `apps/web/src/economy/xp.css` | change | `.xp-reveal__level`, `.xp-reveal__quest-pay` | | `apps/web/src/collection/collection.css` | change | `.tavern.app-shell .collection-set__toggle`, `.tavern.app-shell .collection-list` | | `apps/web/src/routes/leaderboard.css` | change | the `ol, ul` group | | `apps/web/src/routes/stats.css` | change | `.stats-table`, `.stats-grid-figures dd`, `.stats-pager-page` | | `apps/web/src/index.css` | change | new "headlines and prose" section (`text-wrap-style`) | | `apps/web/src/typography.test.ts` | new | the stylesheet test | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | one sentence on the convention | Do not touch: `apps/web/src/packs/pack-object.css` (it draws no digit, see Open questions), anything under `apps/web/src/cards/` (card faces are out of scope), `apps/web/src/fx/css.test.ts`, any `.tsx`, any crate, `spec/`, `e2e/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`. No spec section or ruling governs this. It is presentation only, so there is no new R number and no ruling is cited. CLAUDE.md rule 7 holds because nothing reads state. CLAUDE.md rule 9 does not apply because CSS values are not rules numbers. ## Steps In steps 1–8, "add the line" means: add `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;` (two-space indent) as the **last declaration** of the named block. Change nothing else in it. 1. `apps/web/src/game/clock.css`: add the line to the block that starts at line 50, `.clock-digits {`, after `text-align: right;`. Do not touch `.clock-grace .clock-digits { flex-shrink: 0; }`, because `game/Clock.test.tsx` matches that block's exact text. 2. `apps/web/src/shop/shop.css`: - add the line to `.shop-wallet {` (line 31), after `color: var(--tavern-gold-pale);`; - add the line to `.shop-row__info {` (line 65), after `min-width: 0;`. That block holds the "N unopened" count and the unclassed price `` (`shop/Shop.tsx` lines 172–176); - right after the group `.token-bar, .token-next, .token-held, .cosmetic-packs-held { margin: 0; }` (lines 89–94), add a blank line and then: ```css /* The held counts stand one under another. */ .token-held, .cosmetic-packs-held { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } ``` (`.token-next` shows no number and `.token-bar` is unused, so the group itself stays as it is.) 3. `apps/web/src/packs/packs.css`: add the line to `.packs-held {` (line 194), after `gap: 0.5rem;`. 4. `apps/web/src/economy/economy.css`: add the line to `.fill-bar__caption {` at line 26, after its `color:` line. Leave `.opening-hud .fill-bar__caption` inside the `@media (max-width: 600px)` block alone, because it inherits. 5. `apps/web/src/economy/xp.css`: add the line to `.xp-reveal__level {` (line 37), after `transform-origin: 0 50%;`, and to `.xp-reveal__quest-pay {` (line 55), after its `color:` line. 6. `apps/web/src/collection/collection.css`: add the line to `.tavern.app-shell .collection-set__toggle {` (line 24), after `width: 100%;`, and to `.tavern.app-shell .collection-list {` (line 71), after `list-style: none;`. Neither element holds a `CardFace`. The card grid is `.collection-grid`, a sibling. Do **not** put it on `.collection-set` or `.collection-section`, because both contain card faces and the property inherits. 7. `apps/web/src/routes/leaderboard.css`: add the line to the group `.tavern.app-shell.leaderboard-screen ol, .tavern.app-shell.leaderboard-screen ul {` (lines 10–14), after `padding-left: 22px;`. The `ol` markers are the ranks, and they inherit it. 8. `apps/web/src/routes/stats.css`: add the line to: - `.stats-table {` (line 336), after `font-size: 13.5px;`; - `.stats-grid-figures dd {` (line 321), after `color: var(--text, #fff);`; - `.stats-pager-page {` (line 566), after its `color:` line. Leave `.stats-summary-value` alone (see Open questions). 9. `apps/web/src/index.css`: insert this exactly, followed by one blank line, immediately before the comment line `/* -----…` at line 169. That is the comment whose next line reads ` The shell chrome: /, /login, …`, and the new section goes after the first `.notice code { color: var(--text-dim); }` block (line 165): ```css /* --- headlines and prose (#2123) ----------------------------------------------------------- A paragraph's last line is not left a lone word, and a heading, a dialog's or a toast's title and the result's word share their words evenly between their lines. Only `text-wrap-style`: the `text-wrap` shorthand would also set `text-wrap-mode: wrap` and undo a `white-space: nowrap` the element inherits. The titles come second, so a title that is a

still balances. Card faces are left alone: `cards/fit.ts` measures their text, and a different wrap would change the size it fits. */ p { text-wrap-style: pretty; } h1, h2, h3, .prompt-title, .hero-inspect-title, .challenge-toast__text, .draw-toast__line, .result-overlay__word { text-wrap-style: balance; } ``` What each selector is: `.prompt-title` is the `

` title of every `game/Prompt.tsx` and `game/craft/CraftEditor.tsx` dialog. `.hero-inspect-title` is `emotes/HeroInspect.tsx`'s dialog title. `.challenge-toast__text` and `.draw-toast__line` are the toasts' lines (`together/ChallengeToast.tsx`, `game/DrawOffer.tsx`). `.result-overlay__word` is the result's heading (`game/Result.tsx`). Every other dialog's title is already an `h1`–`h3`. No `.cf` selector goes here. 10. `apps/web/README.md`: at the end of the paragraph that starts "The web fonts (`src/fonts.css`…" and ends "…held equal by `net/cloudflare-config.test.ts`).", append this sentence: ``A number that changes in place or stands in a column (the clock, a count, a price, a wallet, a bar, a rank, a stats table) takes `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`; headings and dialog and toast titles balance their lines and paragraphs wrap pretty (`index.css`, `text-wrap-style`); a card face takes neither, since `cards/fit.ts` measures its text (`src/typography.test.ts`).`` 11. Create `apps/web/src/typography.test.ts` as given under **Tests**. ## Tests Create `apps/web/src/typography.test.ts`. It goes at the top of `src/`, beside `cursors.test.ts`, and **not** under `src/fx/`, which the harness's web run excludes. Its content, in order: ```ts // #2123 (part of #2036): tabular numbers and balanced headlines across the menus. // // Vitest stubs CSS imports, so the sheets are read as text with `node:fs` and parsed as // `fx/css.test.ts` parses them (its parser, copied below): a rule is its selector list, its // declarations and the @media it sits in, so the checks hold whatever the sheet's formatting. // Card faces ````
